snippet.title: Euro Truck Simulator 2: Iceland Video Trailer
snippet.description:
We are excited to reveal the official video trailer and release date for the Iceland DLC for Euro Truck Simulator 2! Get ready to embark on an unforgettable journey through a land shaped by fire, ice, and the forces of nature.

Add the Iceland DLC to your Steam wishlist 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3796990/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2_Iceland/
